artifact.source_owner: UC Berkeley Library Digital Collections / University of California Academic Senate

observed_schema.download_schema: Whole annual memorial biography volume; unstructured narrative PDF with named memorial headings and biographical prose.
observed_schema.header_format: Name, discipline: campus / YYYY-YYYY / academic title / variable narrative

limitations: No ready-made row-level DOB table or bulk JSON/CSV export was observed on the two landing pages. Backend capabilities were not probed.
The annual volume covers deceased UC faculty and administrators, so it is not a national professor roster and not exclusively professors.
Birth-date completeness and number of individual memorial entries were not audited; no individual DOB extraction was performed.
The PDF is a public officially hosted whole-volume download discovered verbatim in search, not a guessed or enumerated endpoint.
The catalogue search result reports 278 pp; the downloaded PDF has 117 physical pages. Page counts are therefore kept separate rather than equated.
stopped_reason: Public request budget reached; usable whole-volume file obtained. No further feasibility exploration needed.
